name: Malcolm McLeod
story: In 1994, Harmsworth and Malcolm McLeod documented Gisborne–East Cape land-resource data for GIS, including rock, landform, land-system and soil information.
Malcolm McLeod of Landcare Research co-authored the 2003 Hokianga and Western Kaipara assessment, contributing the soil and land-resource knowledge used in its regional crop maps.
